overall: The AG found Winchester Community Access & Media is not a "public body" under the OML because it is not within government, so the notice and closed-session allegations were not reached.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the non-profit cable access board met in closed session between July 9 and 12, 2010, without adequate notice, to discuss and terminate two employees.
allegations.key_passage: Wincam does not possess traditional governmental powers such as powers to tax, the power to take property by eminent domain, or the power to regulate coercively individual group conduct.
